description: This file defines IPC message handling classes and templates within the WPEFramework Core namespace, including scalar types, string serialization, text buffers, and frame buffers used for inter-process communication.

classes.name: ScalarType
classes.description: Template class for handling scalar data types with serialization support, specialized for string type.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Template class for fixed-length text buffers with serialization and deserialization capabilities.

classes.name: BufferType
classes.description: Template class for managing byte buffers with serialization/deserialization, based on FrameType.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Gets or sets the scalar value in ScalarType.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the string in ScalarType<string> or Text.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object into a byte buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a byte buffer into the object.
